subject: Evaluation timeline and staged economics for Q2 pilot
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@orbitai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.s@cloudbridge.co>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot evaluation & MAP — OrbitAI x Redwood

Hi Dylan / Priya,

Thanks for taking the time on Friday. We want to formalize an evaluation runbook so procurement can sign off quickly. High-level constraints: 4–6 week pilot, clear success criteria (latency, cost per 1k tokens, quality regressions), and a path to a committed ramp if pilot is successful.

Specifically: can you propose a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties a small initial commit (pilot credits) to a staged discount schedule as we hit usage ramp milestones? Procurement will also need a short security addendum and evidence of KV cache retention policies.

Can you turn around a draft MAP + pricing table by Wed EOD? We’d like a target close within 3 weeks after pilot start if checkpoints are met.

Thanks,
Alex
VP Product, OrbitAI

---
Note: procurement contact is Priya Shah (cc’d).
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@orbitai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.s@cloudbridge.co>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation & MAP — OrbitAI x Redwood

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Attached are two artifacts for initial review: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP narrative + milestone acceptance language) and pricing_matrix_v1.xlsx (staged economics). Highlights below:

- Pilot scope (weeks 0–6): 250k token credit, basic observability, shared support (email + 4 weekly office hours).
- Checkpoint 1 (end of week 2): validation of integration + 100k tokens processed. If passed, unlock 10% committed discount for month 1 of ramp.
- Checkpoint 2 (end of week 4): 1M tokens processed, p50 latency < 350ms on representative profile. If passed, tiered commit offered (see pricing sheet) and an additional 5% discount.
- Ramp commitment: phased commit over 3 months to reach target throughput; discounts scale to 20% at target commit.
- Security/evidence: we’ll include a short security addendum and SOC2 summary; full evidence can be shared via secure Drive link once you sign an NDA (or via your procurement portal).

I’ve tried to keep checkpoint acceptance criteria measurable to match procurement’s needs. I’ll put a DocuSign link in the final when you’re ready. Please review and tell me which parts you want tightened — I can update the MAP wording around checkpoint gating (e.g., what counts as a failed checkpoint, remediation period, and rollback/fallback behaviors).

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP narrative), pricing_matrix_v1.xlsx (staged economics)

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@orbitai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.s@cloudbridge.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation & MAP — OrbitAI x Redwood

Internal note: forwarding for ops + CS input.

On Mon, 09 Mar 2026 at 11:03 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’ve tried to keep checkpoint acceptance criteria measurable to match procurement’s needs.

A couple of operational clarifications we should lock before we send v2:
- Telemetry/retention: OrbitAI needs 90-day retention for traces and token-level logs for evaluation. We can provide that on Dedicated or via a private retention policy for hosted with a limited retention window — need to state this explicitly.
- SLA/backfill: if a checkpoint fails due to infra instability on our side, agreed remediation window is 72 hours and we’ll offer a credit applied to the ramp month, not to the pilot credits.
- Escalation path: name a contact in CS (Marissa) and an engineering on-call for immediate triage during checkpoint windows.

Marissa — can you confirm the p50/p95 targets in the doc and whether the 1M token checkpoint is realistic for our standard instance sizes or whether we should recommend a short autoscale burst window?

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Customer Reliability
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@orbitai.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation & MAP — OrbitAI x Redwood

Thanks Grace — quick ops confirmation and suggested language included in attached MAP_action_items_v2.docx. Key adjustments:

- Checkpoint metrics: make checkpoint 2 criteria explicit: 1M tokens processed within a rolling 7-day window with p50 < 350ms and p95 < 700ms on the agreed profile.
- Autoscale: recommend a 72-hour burst window during checkpoint 2 to surface edge cases; we’ll monitor costs and provide a one-time buffer of credits if autoscale is used for validation.
- Security evidence: we can attach the SOC2 summary and an HSM/KMS diagram; we’ll surface the telemetry retention option as a line item in the final.
- Acceptance wording: propose "Redwood will provide written confirmation that checkpoint criteria have been met; procurement will have 3 business days to accept or request remediation. Failure to accept without comment defaults to acceptance."

I’ve flagged two items that legal may want tighter language on (remediation credit mechanics, and definition of "representative profile").

Attachments: MAP_action_items_v2.docx

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@orbitai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.s@cloudbridge.co>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation & MAP — OrbitAI x Redwood

Alex / Priya — appreciate the quick reviews. I’ve incorporated the ops language and tightened the checkpoint gating per Marissa’s suggestions. Attached is Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf (clean MAP narrative) and I’ve updated the pricing sheet to reflect the 3-stage discount cadence tied to commits.

Next steps I propose:
- OrbitAI reviews Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf and confirms acceptance or requests changes by Mon, Mar 15 EOD PT.
- If accepted, I’ll send a DocuSign bundle (MAP + short SOW + security addendum) — link below.
- Target pilot start: week of Mar 22; pilot length 6 weeks with checkpoints at W2 and W4.
- Close timeline: assuming checkpoints pass, target contract signature within 3 weeks of pilot start (committed ramp begins month+1).

DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.com/sign?session=ABC123
Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf, updated_pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx
